fields.description: Set in Job Applicant Profile Settings. A locked field is read-only on every Job Opening — its configuration there cannot be changed or removed.
fields.label: Locked

fields.description: Set in Job Applicant Profile Settings. Roles that may see this field on the applicant profile. JSON list; ["All"] means everyone, [] means nobody. This is the only permission the settings page configures — the GENERAL / PRE-OFFER RULES columns are per-opening.
fields.label: Profile View Roles

fields.description: Set in Job Applicant Profile Settings. When on, this field only renders for Job Openings admitted by applicability_config. Off means the field is offered to every opening.
fields.label: Applicable To

fields.description: JSON: [{"type": "Company"|"Assignment", "value": "<name>"}]. Edited through the Applicability Settings dialog, never by hand.
fields.label: Applicability Config

fields.description: Roles that may SEE this field on the Job Opening. JSON list; ["All"] means everyone, [] means nobody. Per-opening — set on the Job Opening's Job application tab.
fields.label: Visibility

fields.description: Roles that may EDIT this field on the Job Opening. JSON list; ["All"] means everyone, [] means nobody (read-only for all). Per-opening.
fields.label: Editability

fields.description: Roles that may SEE this field on the pre-offer form. JSON list; ["All"] means everyone, [] means nobody. Per-opening.
fields.label: Pre-offer Visibility

fields.description: Roles that may EDIT or APPROVE this field on the pre-offer form. JSON list; ["All"] means everyone, [] means nobody. Per-opening.
fields.label: Pre-offer Edit/Approve

fields.description: Position of this field within its section, for this opening only. 0 = inherit the order set in Job Applicant Profile Settings.
fields.label: Display Order
